title: THE RACKS PAGE READS AT A GLANCE
why: The critic scored the mainframe racks page 2: a part you could not use looked the same as one you could, the counter was teal, empty slots looked like built ones, rows and columns did not line up and the cost text was small. Disabled buttons are now dashed and empty, built slots are solid green and empty ones dashed, the counter is the text colour, the slots span the build column and the count starts where the friend column starts, and the cost parts are 20px with a short part in red.
now: The racks page shows built and empty slots, usable and unusable buttons, and the parts you are short of, at a glance.
